about: Picked from the A8 design bundle's data/hold_me_golden.json (HoldMe.dc.html renderVals() in node, props dir=a act=pop lie=a coach=seal live=false; canvas version 1795674999-e13f), plus star 220, 460, 620, 1200, 1225 and warning 45, 90, 135 ms with the rig's values from the same renderVals() run in node, parsed into numbers. Keys are ms since the moment began. box [left, top, scale]; me [jx, hop, sx, sy] about the feet; shadow [x, rx]; face the expression (a drawing: its shown tags); pose the rig's moves and path steps (only at some moments); tilt, arm, head a drawing's moves; spark [x, y, scale, opacity]; dust [scaleX, opacity]; shake the lines' numbers; sweat [x, y, rotDeg, scale, opacity] x 3; star [x, y, rotDeg, scale, trail [dx, dy] x 3] on the stage, toward the stage 3 (15, 20, 30 s) or stage 5 (10, 15, 20 s) bar; lit the bar's stars. cheer: [ms since the star, bubble shown, words, owner face, first bar star lit]. Values are rounded to 2 decimals as the mockup prints them.
